subject_uz: Maktabgacha ta'lim muassasasi uchun bolalar tagliklari, hojatxona qog'ozi va qog'oz sochiq xaridi

requirements.summary_uz: Bolalar uchun ko'p qatlamli hojatxona qog'ozi, katta o'lchamli qog'oz sochiq va maxsus tagliklar yetkazib beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Multi-layer toilet paper for children, large paper towels and special diapers are to be supplied.
requirements.quote: bolalar uchun ko'p qatlamli hojatxona qog'ozi, katta o'lchamli qog'oz sochiq, shuningdek maxsus tagliklar haridi

requirements.summary_uz: Mahsulot 2025-yildan avval ishlab chiqarilgan bo'lmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Goods must not have been manufactured before 2025.

requirements.summary_uz: Mahsulotning markirovkasi, qadoqlanishi va tashilishi talablarga mos bo'lishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: Marking, packaging and transport of the goods must meet the stated requirements.

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik tomoni texnik shartga muvofiq bo'lishi kerak; bu mezon 20 ball beradi.
requirements.summary_en: The technical side must match the technical specification; this criterion carries up to 20 points.
requirements.quote: Texnik tomoni, texnik shartga muvofiq bo'lishi kerak (majburiy)

requirements.summary_uz: Mahsulot sertifikatlari (sanitariya-epidemiologik xulosa va boshqalar) ball bilan baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Product certificates (sanitary-epidemiological conclusion etc.) are scored.

requirements.summary_uz: Yetkazib berish davriyligi va miqdori bo'yicha hujjat taqdim etiladi va baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: A document on delivery frequency and quantity is submitted and scored.

requirements.summary_uz: Ekologik, gigiyenik sertifikatlar, sinov bayonnomalari va muvofiqlik sertifikatlari talab qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: Environmental and hygiene certificates, test reports and conformity certificates are required.
requirements.quote: Экологик, гигиеник сертификатлаш, калибрлаш тўғрисидаги тегишли гувоҳномалар ёки синов баённомалари

requirements.summary_uz: Bank kafolati yoki zakalat kiritilganini tasdiqlovchi hujjat talab qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: Proof of a deposit or the original bank guarantee is required.
requirements.quote: Закалат киритилганлигини тасдиқловчи ҳужжат ёки банк кафолатининг асл нусхаси

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik shartga aniq amal qilinmasa, shartnoma bekor qilinishi yoki taklif ko'rib chiqilmasligi mumkin.
requirements.summary_en: If the specification is not followed exactly, the contract may be cancelled or the bid not considered.
requirements.quote: Aks holda shartnoma bekor bo'lishi yoki taklif ko'rib chiqilmasligi yohud diskvalifikatsiyaga sabab bo'lishi mumkin

documents_needed_uz: Davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganlik guvohnomasi va ta'sis hujjatlari
Sertifikatlar (sanitariya-epidemiologik xulosa, muvofiqlik sertifikati, sifat sertifikati)
Markirovka, qadoqlash va tashish bo'yicha hujjat
Manfaatlar to'qnashuvi va affillanganlik holatlari yo'qligi haqida ariza
